name: market-structure-bos-choch
description: Market structure analysis — Break of Structure (BOS), Change of Character (CHoCH), premium/ discount, market structure shifts, and candle-close swing validation (Jonathan Jarvis method). Use for "BOS", "break of structure", "CHoCH", "change of character", "market structure shift", "MSS", "structure break", "higher high higher low", "lower high lower low", "internal structure", "swing structure", "valid high", "valid low", "candle close validation", "mechanical structure", "Norfolk FX", or any market structure concept. Works on all assets (Forex, crypto, indices) and all timeframes. Core SMC/ICT concept. Works with liquidity-order-flow-mapper, ict-smart-money, smc-beginner-pro-guide, and price-action.
